description: Whether a product (or one of its variants) can be bought in a given quantity right now, and what that quantity costs: unit_price and total (unit price × quantity, calculated by the shop). When the customer asks how much several units cost, call it with that qty and say its total: never multiply yourself.

product_id.description: The id of the product, from search_products

session_id.description: Only if your client does not keep the MCP session (the Mcp-Session-Id header): the session_id that an earlier answer of this server gave you. It keeps the same cart between calls.

variant_id.description: The id of the variant (colour, size…), from get_product; 0 for a product without variants

name: check_availability
